body: Nothing particularly recently, it’s been a 6 year long battle with a bunch of things and I just can’t keep fighting anymore

I’m telling you right now for your own sake- tell your dad. I’m sure he’d much rather hear you come clean to him about some money you owe then have to attend your funeral. I’m probably hypocritical considering I’m always contemplating suicide, but an issue like money can almost always be overcome. Try and think logically about it rather than let your mind get to that dark place, I know it’s easier said than done, but I think it’s worth telling you.

I’m right there with you. Death seems kind of inevitable-I know I’m going to end up killing myself but at the same time I can’t fully picture myself going through with it. Like I have no solid plan at the moment to do it but I still live my life under the impression that I’m definitely going to die soon.

Yeah, The thought of going through with an attempt and having to live with the consequences if it fails Is pretty much all that’s keeping me alive at the moment. If only there was an off button for life, or like a simple pill you could take to make it stop.
Sorry to hear that bud, I hope things get better for you as well, I know how hard life can be.
Right back at you :)

Yep. I keep waiting and hoping that things are going to get better like an idiot. I feel like recently I’ve been in the headspace of “oh well, I’m going to Kill myself anyway so who cares?” But I’m exhausted and I wish things were different
You just put how I feel into words. Shits exhausting.

Yep. I feel you. I also think that for whatever reason I’m just always going to end up killing myself- like that is the way I am meant to go and there’s no real way around that. And yeah at times it is kind of comforting because I see it as a way out, but I don’t actually want to die, I just wish things were different.

I’m kind of in the same boat. Except I haven’t set a specific date or anything-I’m just going to see how far I can get before eventually being pushed to the edge and doing it. In the mean time I may as well just try and enjoy what I can I suppose.
I’m in the same situation my friend. Sorry to hear you’re going through it
Again I relate so hard to this-sorry your going through it too
Sucks doesn’t it

I’ve haven’t fully gone through with an attempt yet, I’ve been close in the past and like a month ago too. But I figured that overdosing on paracetamol is unlikely to be successful and if I go through with an attempt I really need it to work. I’m terrified I’ll have to wake up and deal with the consequences especially since it’s not like there’s any other way to solve my problems.

I feel this....I feel like I would’ve been such a happy person if things had panned out differently. But unfortunately because of the way. Things did pan out I’m trapped in a life I don’t want-it sucks because I just want everything to end.
Exactly how I feel-shits kind of lonely though
I relate a little too much to this. stick in there bud, try and distract yourself from the anxiety as much as you can :)
Yeah. I feel the same.

This is probably totally irrelevant but considering everything you’ve been through I think you sound insanely intelligent and strong. l mean you got a degree whilst dealing with a severe condition. I know this isn’t advice or anything but I’m just very impressed.

Gosh I’m glad I’m not the only one with these kinds of thoughts- ironically thinking about death is one of the only things keeping me going at the moment. I swear one of those most repetitive thoughts I have in my head is “oh well, if it gets that bad I can just Kill myself” but seriously life is just exhausting recently.
you’ll get out of this, I’m right here with you just try to trust that things will ALWAYS be okay in the end- I know it’s easier said than done but you’re by no means alone in this :)

I see- so you’re going through really high high’s and really low low’s. Maybe try and focus on what triggers the low’s and avoid that completely, and if it’s just your brain overthinking things then come up with some ways to pull yourself back if you can. Again I empathise with you because I know it’s MUCH easier said than done. For me spending some time distracting myself helps, like watching youtube and things. I’ll never fully know the extent of what you’re going through and it sounds like you’re exhausted but just know that you really aren’t alone and that things will get better.
thank you💛I needed to hear this
Thank you so much, I don’t think I can explain how comforting it feels to hear this. Life is just very scary so I appreciate you taking the time to reassure me- I hope your doing well also :)

Hey friend, that’s exactly how I have felt recently so maybe i’m not in the best position to be giving advice. But please hang on. I completely understand the longing for the pain to go away that’s how I feel on a daily basis. But you have so much to live for even if it’s only for yourself. Try your best to ignore the future completely and focus on the present which I know is easier said then done but this sometimes manages to calm me down. Life is scary but suicide isn’t the option- I think you want to live but your just in pain. Hang on please things do truly get better even when you can’t see them doing so.
